japan1.title: 全日空 上位の特典制度の変更を見直しへ 厳しい意見受け
japan1.description: 全日空は、飛行機の利用の多い人などが会員になって発行できるクレジットカードの特典制度を2028年度から変更すると発表していましたが、利用者から厳しい意見などが多く寄せられたことを理由に、変更内容を見直すことになりました。

japan1.title: 先週の株式市場 個人の株式売買金額が過去最高に
japan1.description: 日経平均株価が初めて7万円を超え、5日連続で最高値を更新した先週、国内の株式市場では個人投資家による株式の売買金額が過去最高となったことがわかりました。

japan1.title: 5月のデパート売り上げ 5か月連続増加 免税品好調で
japan1.description: 全国のデパートの先月の売り上げは4683億円余りと、5か月連続で前の年より増加しました。円安傾向が続き、外国人旅行者向けの免税品が好調だったことが主な要因です。

japan1.title: 景気動向指数「改善」に上方修正 71か月上昇傾向続く
japan1.description: ことし4月の景気動向指数の改訂値は、景気の現状を示す「一致指数」が速報値を上回る118.1となり、内閣府は景気の基調判断を「改善を示している」に上方修正しました。景気動向指数の上昇傾向は71か月続いていて、専門家からは今後、景気拡大の期間が「いざなみ景気」を超え、戦後最も長くなる可能性があるという見方も出ています。

japan1.title: 円相場1ドル＝161円台後半での取り引き 市場介入警戒も
japan1.description: 25日の東京外国為替市場、円相場は1ドル＝161円台後半で取り引きされ、神経質な値動きとなりました。

japan1.title: 日銀 田村委員“利上げは物価動向次第でちゅうちょなく”
japan1.description: 日銀の金融政策の決定に関わる田村直樹 審議委員が25日、神戸市で講演し、今月の利上げに続いて今後は数か月に一度のペースで利上げを進める必要があり、物価の動向次第ではペースを加速するべきだという考えを示しました。

japan1.title: キオクシアが株主総会 時価総額国内トップ AI普及で急成長
japan1.description: 生成AIの普及を背景に手がける半導体の需要が急増し、時価総額が国内首位となった「キオクシアホールディングス」の株主総会が開かれ、太田裕雄社長はAIがけん引する形で今後も半導体の旺盛な需要が続くという見方を示しました。

japan1.title: 東京電力の新会長に横尾敬介氏就任 他社との提携が焦点
japan1.description: 東京電力ホールディングスは、25日に開かれた株主総会を経て、新たな会長に横尾敬介氏が就任したと発表しました。新体制のもと抜本的な経営改善につながる他社との提携を実現できるかが焦点となります。

japan1.title: 中部電力の株主総会 会長・社長の取締役選任案が可決
japan1.description: 中部電力の株主総会が名古屋市で開かれ、会社側が提出した取締役の選任案が可決されて、勝野哲会長と林欣吾社長の再任が決まりました。浜岡原子力発電所の審査で地震の想定に関して不正なデータ処理などを行っていた問題を受け、株主が出した2人の解任を求める提案は否決されました。

japan1.title: 株価 3100円以上値上がり 終値で最高値を更新
japan1.description: 25日の東京株式市場、半導体関連の需要が堅調だという見方から、多くの銘柄に買い注文が広がって日経平均株価は3100円以上値上がりして、終値としての最高値を更新しました。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz6月25日(木) クールジャパン機構 統廃合検討へ
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: みらい 与野党の議員対象にAI勉強会を開催 安野党首が講師
japan1.description: チームみらいは与野党の国会議員を対象にAIの勉強会を開き、エンジニアの経験を持つ安野党首が活用するメリットや利用上の注意点を解説しました。

japan1.title: ホンダと日産 次世代車の基幹部品を共通化 開発費を軽減
japan1.description: ホンダと日産自動車が、ソフトウエアの更新で性能をアップデートできる次世代の車「SDV」の開発をめぐり、一部の基幹部品を共通化する方向で協議を進めていることがわかりました。巨額の開発費の負担を軽減するねらいで、2029年以降、両社の車に搭載することを目指すとしています。

japan1.title: NY原油 一時1バレル＝70ドル割れ 3か月半ぶり安値水準
japan1.description: 24日のニューヨーク原油市場では、ホルムズ海峡をめぐる状況が改善し中東からの原油の供給が回復に向かうとの期待感から、国際的な取り引きの指標となるWTIの先物価格はことし3月上旬以来、およそ3か月半ぶりに一時、1バレル＝70ドルを下回りました。

japan1.title: 17戦略分野への投資額 2040年度までに「370兆円超」
japan1.description: 政府の経済財政諮問会議などの合同会議が開かれ、新たな成長戦略の策定に向けて、AI・半導体や造船など17の戦略分野に官民が連携して投資する規模を2040年度までに「総額370兆円を超える」と想定する計画をまとめました。高市総理大臣は予算編成のあり方を見直し、複数年度の計画に基づく「『強く豊かな日本』投資枠」を創設する考えを示しました。

japan1.title: 不正アクセスで情報漏えいのKDDIに報告徴収 総務省
japan1.description: KDDIが取引先の企業に提供しているメールシステムに不正なアクセスがあり、最大1400万件余りのメールアドレスなどが漏えいした可能性があることを受けて、総務省は、会社に詳しい原因や再発防止策などを報告するよう求める行政処分を行いました。

japan1.title: 官民ファンド クールジャパン機構 累積赤字拡大 統廃合検討へ
japan1.description: 政府と民間が共同で出資する官民ファンド「クールジャパン機構」は24日、昨年度までの累積赤字が540億円に拡大したと発表しました。累積赤字の目標を達成できなかったため、政府は統廃合に向けた検討を進め、年内をめどに結論を出すことにしています。

japan1.title: 日産株主総会 再任否決された永井氏の賛成率は48％余

japan1.title: 日銀 植田総裁 今後も中東情勢見ながら利上げ検討の姿勢示す

japan1.title: 円相場 1ドル＝161円台 神経質な値動きに

aus1.title: Hundreds of deaths recorded as heatwave continues to grip Europe
aus1.description: At least 101 million Europeans were forecast to swelter in temperatures over 35 degrees on Thursday, with hundreds of people believed to have been killed by the heatwave.

aus1.title: Thousands feared dead after Venezuela quakes as rescuers race to find survivors
aus1.description: At least 164 people have been killed and nearly 1,000 others injured in Venezuela with the death toll expected to climb, according to the country's acting president.

aus1.title: NFL player faces life in prison over kidnapping, armed robbery allegations
aus1.description: NFL player Terrion Arnold has been arrested and is facing multiple felony charges tied to the investigation of an alleged kidnapping and armed robbery in February.

aus1.title: ICAC told of request to alter university contract timelines
aus1.description: The corruption watchdog has been told a University of Wollongong manager was asked to amend timelines to obscure a potential conflict of interest involving a senior staffer and a consultancy contract that would eventually be worth $3.7 million.

aus1.title: Lions roar back in form with big win over Swans
aus1.description: The defending champions, Brisbane, make a statement with a big win over second-placed Sydney at the Gabba.

aus1.title: 'Everybody is equal at the table': Inside the ACT's Circle Sentencing court
aus1.description: A pilot program allowing First Nations offenders to be sentenced by magistrates sitting alongside elders in the ACT Supreme Court secures funding for another three years.

aus1.title: Qantas axes Alice Springs-Melbourne route amid high cost, falling demand
aus1.description: Qantas has axed its direct Alice Springs-Melbourne route after "many decades", and will also restrict flights between Darwin and Singapore to the peak tourist season.

aus1.title: Illawarra man admits to making offensive online comment about PM
aus1.description: A Wollongong man has pleaded guilty to using a carriage service to menace, harass, or cause offence after posting an online comment about Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese.

aus1.title: Antic's 'dangerous' comments on vaccinations condemned
aus1.description: South Australian Liberal senator Alex Antic has been roundly condemned over comments he made about vaccinations after avian influenza was found on Australia's southern coast.

aus1.title: Australia flags strengthening of social media ban
aus1.description: Australia will strengthen its social media ban for young people as a priority amid concerns the powers behind the world-first laws are not strong enough.

aus1.title: 'Nowhere near good enough': Eels coach fumes over error-ridden performance
aus1.description: Parramatta coach Jason Ryles has said his side's performance on Thursday night was not good enough to "beat a park football", going down 32-12 to the South Sydney Rabbitohs.

aus1.title: SA nurses and midwives offered 16 per cent pay rise under new deal
aus1.description: Nurses and midwives in South Australia would receive a 16 per cent pay rise by mid-2028 under a new deal endorsed by their union and the state government.

aus1.title: Truck stuck for almost five minutes before it was hit by express train
aus1.description: An ATSB investigation found a truck was stuck on a Brisbane level crossing for almost five minutes before being hit by a train.

aus1.title: Ex-AFL umpire to stand trial over alleged Brownlow fraud
aus1.description: Ex-AFL umpire Michael Pell, accused of leaking information on confidential Brownlow votes, has been ordered to stand trial.

aus1.title: 72yo man accused of 'offensive' graffiti banned from Sydney suburbs
aus1.description: A 72-year-old man arrested over dozens of alleged graffiti and malicious damage offences in Sydney's inner west has been granted bail, after a judge expressed surprise that he was not charged under NSW hate speech laws.

aus1.title: 'Overjoyed': Shark attack victim reunited with daughter after waking from coma
aus1.description: The 34-year-old's brother said she was awake, speaking with loved ones and her medical team and "remembers the whole event in detail".

aus1.title: Parent asks if 'warning signs' missed after Chinese language school closure
aus1.description: The shock closure of a Chinese language school after 17 years leaves parents and teachers with "unanswered questions" over the school's financial management.

aus1.title: SA council elections delayed amid review into March poll
aus1.description: The state government has passed legislation to delay South Australia's council elections until April 2027, after the Electoral Commission raised "very serious concerns" about its ability to administer the poll in November.

aus1.title: Hanson faces scrutiny as media landscape shifts around her
aus1.description: Parliament House has been Pauline's World lately but increased visibility comes with increased scrutiny and this week revealed that One Nation is not untouchable.

aus1.title: NT outlaw bikie gang president sentenced to 13 years in prison
aus1.description: Secretly taped phone calls have captured the former president of the Mongols bikie gang's Northern Territory chapter discussing interstate drug deals while helping supply methamphetamine worth almost $800,000 to customers across the Top End.

aus1.title: ABC fishing star rescued from rough seas after boat capsizes
aus1.description: The voice of John "Stinker" Clarke is well known to those who love to wet a line, but there was no-one around to hear a cry for help when his boat capsized north of Newcastle.

aus1.title: Conspiracy theorist podcaster jailed for stabbing girlfriend to death with dagger
aus1.description: Tobias Nuttall is sentenced to at least 18 years behind bars for murdering his girlfriend with a 25-centimetre dagger in a "vicious" attack in her suburban Perth home.

aus1.title: The calls for Australia to play its best attacking weapons are loud
aus1.description: Tony Popovic dances to his own selection tune, but that doesn't mean there aren't loud calls for him to select Australia's most attacking weapons against Paraguay.

aus1.title: Cairns mayor admits misconduct for sharing confidential information
aus1.description: Amy Eden says she accepts a tribunal's findings of misconduct against her for twice leaking confidential information to a journalist. But she has defended her decision to shut down councillors' questions about her admission in the council chamber.

aus1.title: Sea bird sick with H5 avian flu landed by bodyboarders, too weak to fly to shore
aus1.description: A surfer who spotted the first bird in South Australia to test positive for H5N1 bird flu says the giant petrel looked fatigued and distressed before it was retrieved by wildlife rescuers.

bang3.title: Rohingya genocide case to proceed
bang3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bang3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bang3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bang3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bang3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bang3.title: CU admin identifies 2 molesters
bang3.description: The administration of Chittagong University yesterday claimed to have identified two persons who sexually assaulted a female student on the campus on Sunday night.

bang3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bang3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bang3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bang3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bang3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bang3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bang3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bang3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bang3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bang3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bang3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it
bang3.description: The BNP yesterday skipped Election Commission’s dialogue seeking recommendations of political parties on how to hold a free and fair general election.

bd3.title: CU admin identifies 2 molesters
bd3.description: The administration of Chittagong University yesterday claimed to have identified two persons who sexually assaulted a female student on the campus on Sunday night.

bd3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bd3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bd3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bd3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bd3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bd3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bd3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bd3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bd3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bd3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bd3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it
bd3.description: The BNP yesterday skipped Election Commission’s dialogue seeking recommendations of political parties on how to hold a free and fair general election.
